messages.author: 9f9259ebe8f7924f
messages.subject: Text, margins principal()
parts:
Hi there: I'm producing a report on a principal component analysis using principal() in the psych package.  I've used 
>print.psych(model, sort=TRUE, cut=0.3)
to produce the output that is attached.  Is there a way I can prevent the text from bleeding outside the shaded background?
Thank you

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Text, margins principal()
parts:
Two possibilities:

1. increase your page width (e.g. with the geometry package)
2. use the listings package (render_listings(), e.g.
https://github.com/yihui/knitr-examples/blob/master/015-listings.Rnw)

Regards,
Yihui
